Handler pairs off-peak rules
Staff will learn one way of working
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: this section sets the handling standard for animal travel requests, care checks, and handoff control across Aurelia Skyways.

The desk accepts only clear, complete requests and passes them to trained staff without delay. Each animal is matched to a care plan that reflects species, temperament, and comfort needs. The senior coordinator confirms that the cabin team is ready to monitor the animal during flight and that supplies are in place before release to the gate. When a traveler raises concern, the agent listens carefully, records the issue in plain language, and escalates it at once if welfare or compliance may be affected.

On low-traffic days, staff keep movement orderly, use the approved carrier path, and avoid unnecessary handling. The animal must remain calm, secure, and under direct supervision at every transfer point. If a traveler presents with multiple animals, staff separate the review of each case and do not merge instructions. If a pet shows distress, the handler pauses the process, checks for signs of strain, and informs the supervisor. <<FACT F024>> No one leaves a relief area unsecured, and the assigned attendant confirms access before the animal is escorted. <<FACT F018>> The desk also keeps the traveler informed of next steps in direct, simple language.

Any exception requires supervisor approval, and no staff member may improvise a handoff or bypass the record. Contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor for any unresolved animal travel issue.
